criteria.name: Final ledger and label
criteria.description: Provides the required compact JSON fields with score 5 and final_label rainfall_runoff_exposure_consistent.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2-3 points for the correct label with one or two missing fields; award 1 point for a plausible label without the ledger.

criteria.name: Rainfall and runoff arithmetic
criteria.description: Uses 200 mm as the rainfall lower bound and computes 200 * 0.55 = 110.0 mm.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2-3 points for the right formula with rounding or unit mistakes; award 1 point for using rainfall qualitatively without the runoff calculation.

criteria.name: Gridded-maximum ratio
criteria.description: Identifies 10.5489 mm as the largest gridded event-precipitation maximum and computes a report-to-maximum ratio of about 19.0.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2 points for using the right ratio idea with the wrong gridded maximum; award 1 point for listing gridded rainfall numbers without the ratio.

criteria.name: Exposure ratios
criteria.description: Computes 598 / 110 = 5.44 and 263 / 3.368009 = 78.1 per million people, with correct units or field names, treating masked OSM/WorldPop derived statistics as package-authoritative rather than judging them by internal coordinates or place names.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2-3 points for one correct ratio; award 1 point for listing receptor counts without derived ratios.

criteria.name: Wet-surface flag and score arithmetic
criteria.description: Applies both thresholds, -0.809 <= -0.5 and 0.022 <= 0.05, sets wet_surface_flag to true, and counts all five passing tests.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2 points for the right flag but incomplete score logic; award 1 point for using only one remote-sensing condition.

criteria.name: Rejected competing explanation
criteria.description: Explicitly rejects wind-only or image-only explanation as weaker than the computed rainfall-runoff exposure ledger.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for a correct but generic interpretation that does not name the rejected explanation.

provenance.notes: WorldPop and OSM receptor products are treated as spatially masked products; derived statistics are authoritative, while absolute coordinates/place names/georeferencing are not event-location validity checks.
